issues.what: 'Science classes name six forms of energy' overstates: lists vary (many add nuclear, some magnetic or gravitational); Florida's SC.5.P.10.1 is the six-form source.
issues.fix: 'Light, heat, sound, electrical, chemical and mechanical energy are all forms of energy. What do scientists mean by energy?'

issues.what: 'work' in the key is the physics sense, never taught here; a 10-year-old reads it as a job. The key still lands through 'or cause change'.
issues.fix: Keep (it is Virginia SOL 5.2's and Teach Engineering's wording).

issues.what: 'Thermal energy' is dead for a battery in a drawer and 'Light energy' is weak; the live contest is chemical against electrical (M1), which is the point. That is built into a form-naming question with six forms to choose from.

'Light and electricity' is the wrong lure. 'Changes electrical energy into electricity' is a non-change a child sees through, and a child taught the closed loop (electric-circuits) knows the current does flow on out of the bulb and back to the battery, so it is half-defensible. facts.md sources it to M5 (electricity is used up), but M5 is the belief behind 'Only light', not this one. With 'Light and sound' weak, only 'Only light' is live.
issues.fix: Replace 'Light and electricity' with 'Light and chemical energy' (energy sent back into the battery; author's judgment as a child's idea of a loop that refills).

issues.what: The key says 'heat' while three of the unit's other items offer 'Thermal energy' as a choice; nothing in this item ties the two names together.
issues.fix: Context: 'Every bulb gives off some heat (thermal energy) along with its light.'

issues.what: 'The battery' and 'The screen' are dead (no child thinks a screen plays a voice), so it is speaker against microphone (M7). 'Speaker' also carries its job in its everyday name.
issues.fix: Replace 'The screen' with 'The antenna' (the part a child links with a call arriving). Keep 'The microphone' and 'The battery'.

issues.what: 'The Moon' is the weakest lure for wind and coal; 'Earth's hot core' (coal, M8) and 'Earth's spinning' (wind, M6) are live.
'Chemical energy' and 'Thermal energy' are dead for rushing water, so only 'Electrical energy' (M9) is live, and 'rushes' and 'spins' point at motion.
issues.fix: Replace 'Thermal energy' with 'Sound energy' (rushing water roars, but sound does not turn the wheels). Keep 'Electrical energy' and 'Chemical energy'.

issues.what: Each lure's own words name its form ('warmed', 'ringing'), and the stem says each holds a different form, so a child sets two aside and weighs the sandwich against the spring. That is real form knowledge; acceptable.

'each holds a different form': a ringing bell's energy is vibration (mechanical) that it gives off as sound, so the spring and the bell are not cleanly different forms; the context's 'gives off' is the accurate verb.
issues.fix: 'Four everyday things each hold or give off energy, each a different form of it.'

unit_notes: OVERLAP: none with the four finished T1 units. 2ee208e3d3's lures use other units' keys on purpose ('A push or a pull' is pushes-pulls-and-gravity dc2ec7a7b1's key; 'takes up space' is matter-made-of-tiny-particles 33a64311ff's definition of matter); that teaches the distinction and is fine. WITHIN THE UNIT: ba098c2519 (a battery stores chemical energy) and 94bd35a366 (a sandwich holds chemical energy) both key chemical energy. They test different beliefs (the battery 'holds electricity', M1; food as stored energy), and the scope names both food and batteries, so keep both. 718bf2f525, 0712be9448 and c8a4aea049 share the 'X into Y' energy-change form with a reversed lure; they are three different devices from the scope, which is fine. NAMING: the unit mixes 'heat' and 'thermal energy', 'motion' and 'mechanical energy' across items (25a9861767's key 'heat'; 718bf2f525's key 'motion'; ba1e7368d6's key 'Mechanical energy'). Each item stands alone in play, so each context that uses the second name should give the pair once: 'thermal energy (heat)', 'mechanical energy (motion)'. SCOPE: fully covered (the forms, the flashlight chain, the fan, the speaker, the solar panel, the Sun as the source); the dam (ba1e7368d6) is an extra on mechanical energy and fine. FOR LATER BRIEFS: electric-circuits (T1) has 'A circuit turns electrical energy into light, sound, motion or heat' in its scope, which repeats 25a9861767, 718bf2f525 and 0712be9448; that brief must key the circuit itself (closed loop, switch, conductors), not the device's energy change. kinetic-and-potential-energy (T2) lists the squeezed spring and food, fuel and batteries as potential energy; it must key the names kinetic and potential, not again 'a sandwich holds chemical energy'. how-plants-make-food keeps 'the energy in food first came from the Sun'; 49ce602a30 rightly uses wind and coal instead. No voice slips, singular 'they', stance or teen-frame problems found.
